Short title and commencement

Act No
Act No. XV of 1948
Indian Merchant Shipping (Amendment) Act, 1948.
An Act to amend the Indian
Merchant Shipping Act 1923 (XXI of 1923)
Whereas it is
expedient to amend the Indian Merchant Shipping Act, 1923 in the manner and for
the purpose hereinafter appearing;-
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.--- (1) This Act may be called the Indian Merchant Shipping
(Amendment) Act, 1948.
(2) It shall come
into, force at once.

Amendment of section 11

Act No
Act No. XV of 1948
Indian Merchant Shipping (Amendment) Act, 1948.
An Act to amend the Indian
Merchant Shipping Act 1923 (XXI of 1923)
Whereas it is
expedient to amend the Indian Merchant Shipping Act, 1923 in the manner and for
the purpose hereinafter appearing;-
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 11.-Sub-section (4) of section
11 of the said Act shall be re-numbered as sub-section (5), and after sub
section (3) the following sub-section shall be inserted, namely:
"(4) The Central
Government may, by written order, exempt any ship or class of ships from the
restrictions imposed by sub-section (1), (2) or (3) of this section."
